codes.E_AUDIO_FORMAT: RIFF/WAVE container is syntactically invalid or not 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM.
codes.E_AUDIO_MISSING: A referenced audio file is absent.
codes.E_CALIB_BUDGET_PENDING: The per-batch turn budget was exhausted; unresolved turns remain queued.
codes.E_CONFIG_INVALID: Calibration or injection configuration is invalid.
codes.E_CONFIG_MISMATCH: Snapshot version or base configuration hash does not match the runtime.
codes.E_DIALOGUE_INVALID: Dialogue schema or turn linkage is invalid.
codes.E_EDIT_INVALID: An edit command is malformed or cannot be applied.
codes.E_INJECTED_FAULT: An enabled deterministic injection fault was raised.
codes.E_INTERNAL: An unexpected stage exception was isolated and reported.
codes.E_SNAPSHOT_INVALID: Snapshot files are missing or unreadable.
